latest_observation: account_views now also owns the accounts report helper; status_views now also owns the permissions report, runtime-status render helper, provider-limit summary helper, overview render helper, health render helper, remediations render helper, agent capability-surface helper used by roles context, and the agent baseline render helper; provider limit snapshot record/clear helpers remain in status_views; status_views also owns the sources/update repo-health helpers and the source reference manifest helper; shell_views now also owns shell backend, shell progress, prompt menu, interactive command checks, the shell command rewrite helper, and the last-step outcome transcript helper; project/role_flow now also owns the project tolerance profile plus the role tolerance margin set/reset helpers and the PRINCE2 role assignment helper, role-node remove helper, baseline builder, and node mutation helpers; project/role_views now also owns the PRINCE2 role assignments render helper; cli_dispatch now also owns the parser builder internally without recursive delegation through main and now persists a project-tree clarification question when AI-assisted proposal still needs brief clarification; model_views owns the catalog block, catalog-entry display helper, provider-model display helpers, guided model-choice bridge, and cloud-priority model chooser; json_schema_registry now also owns the shared with_json_schema helper; agent_setup_views now owns the agent workspace setup and runtime permission refresh helpers; extension_views owns the extension discovery/report helpers and cli_dispatch now routes extensions through it directly; shell_views owns interactive completion plus approval/rate-limit helpers; project/design_flow now also owns the local execution candidates report helper; project/tree_flow now renders the project-tree clarification question in the textual output; the refactor target now explicitly converges on MVC-style module separation and the agent should support controlled recursive command handling/self-instantiation of sub-agents when decomposing work; project start still proceeds with runtime local candidates and status/statusline remain routed through the status report paths. model preference load/save/apply and PRINCE2 role-sync helpers now live in stagewarden/model_views.py, so main.py only keeps thin bridges for those flows. command_views now owns the shared parse_limit helper and cli_dispatch now owns the LJSON path helpers, so the last utility bodies can stay out of main.py.
